svg.title: Where the plug-ins land in a design flow
svg.desc: Seven stages of a design flow, each with its plug-in. Requirements and spec: read-only dumps of the requirements database and guarded copy-and-patch writes. Architecture and models: generated behavioural harnesses checked against the simulator. Schematic entry: build scripts that address terminals by name. Simulation and characterisation: one swept test spread across a farm, mismatch campaigns rolled up flat. Reliability and stress: benches for fresh, stressed and aged parts. Documentation and review: decks and figures built by script and checked as rendered images. Production test handoff: test procedures staged in the requirements database. Artifact QA runs on every output. At every stage the decisions stay with the engineer: limits, waivers, corner acceptance, ship or redesign.
